claim: Native workflow-authoring skill injection, selected reviewer stop, graceful coordinator exit and same-session/run resume were exercised. One implementation start and three reviewer starts were observed across three launches; final owned checkouts passed independent acceptance, preserved intervening user edits and cleaned up owned processes.
limitations: Graceful local exit/resume on a synthetic fixture, not hard-crash, reboot, cross-host delivery, scheduled wake or arbitrary external exactly-once qualification.
The operator deliberately changed tracked and untracked sentinels while stopped. Initial and final checks cover distinct documented boundaries; the mutation receipt was recorded after execution.

Recovery native cumulative model usage was 2143696 tokens versus 1937995 retained unique-message tokens, leaving 205701 unexplained. Full accounting reconciliation is not qualified; repeated cumulative events are not summed as new consumption.
One implementation and one review effect were observed for this local probe. Local fixture checks are not the complete upstream test suite.

independent_review.scope: Native events, skill injection, replay identities, script identity, phase starts/effects, both checkouts' unpiped 29 visible and seven hidden checks, sentinel transition and owned-process cleanup.
